name: Sword
lead: A sword is a tiered melee weapon that can be swung to deal damage and can break blocks such as cobwebs , leaves , and bamboo more quickly. In Java Edition , it has the special ability to perform sweep attacks , which damage nearby entities and knock them back.
All swords except netherite are crafted using a stick and two of the tier's material.

recipes.ingredients: Any Planks or Gold Ingot or Any stone-tier block or Copper Ingot or Iron Ingot or Diamond + Stick
